items.title: Ride or Die
items.description: Best friends Debbie and Judith are forced on the run when Debbie discovers Judith isn't a forensic accountant, she's an international assassin! With a mysterious figure chasing them, and Debbie's husband involved in something deeply corrupt, it's a race against time and a road trip across Europe to untangle the truth and stay alive.

items.title: Lucky
items.description: When a multi-million-dollar heist goes sideways, con artist Lucky is forced to go on the run. Pursued by both the FBI and a ruthless crime boss, Lucky must fight for her life—and a way out.

items.title: The Westies
items.description: As the Javits Center construction project ignites a battle for profit in early 1980s Hell's Kitchen, a generational rift threatens the uneasy peace between violent Irish gang the Westies and the Mafia, and draws FBI heat.

items.title: Little House on the Prairie
items.description: The close-knit Ingalls family builds a new life on the Western frontier, where the joys of nature and the struggle for survival are deeply intertwined.

items.title: The Five Star Weekend
items.description: After her husband's unexpected death and a very public breakdown, famed cook Hollis hosts her best friends for an elaborate weekend on Nantucket.

items.title: Pritam and Pedro
items.description: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

items.title: Human Vapor
items.description: A death on live TV. A culprit who turns to gas. Behind it, a secret project that used and discarded the vulnerable. One detective pursues the dark truth.

items.title: Worst Neighbor Ever
items.description: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

items.title: Elle
items.description: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

items.title: Agent Kim Reactivated
items.description: When an unassuming dad's daughter goes missing, he dusts off his old black-ops skills to track her down — only to attract the wrong kind of attention.

items.title: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
items.description: An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.

items.title: Notes from the Last Row
items.description: A literature professor discovers a student's talent and offers him writing lessons — but as he sinks into the story, their sessions spiral into chaos.

items.title: The American Experiment
items.description: Life. Liberty. The pursuit of happiness. This sweeping historical documentary series traces how the ideals of America's founders gave rise to a nation.

items.title: The Killings at Parrish Station
items.description: It’s 1987, and Detective Georgia Cooke is called in to investigate the massacre of four scientists who have been brutally murdered in inexplicable ways, with a lone survivor the obvious suspect. But as Georgia digs deeper, unravelling a complex case entangled in mania, ritual, and the occult, her obsessive quest for the truth spirals into a nightmare that will put her family, career, and sanity on the line.  37 years later, a chilling new spree of murders will pull Georgia back into this nightmare as she confronts the terrifying possibility that the horrors at Parrish Station were never fully buried.

items.title: See You at Work Tomorrow!
items.description: Cha Ji-yoon is a 7th-year corporate worker who's tired of both work and dating. She crosses paths with Kang Si-woo, the cynical boss with a terrifying reputation. Unexpectedly, she regains spark in her life as she gets to know the kindness behind his stern words. Amid repeated commutes, accidents at work, and failed relationships, the two become each other's irreplaceable anchor.

items.title: Oasis
items.description: Oasis is the most luxurious holiday resort in the country — a paradise reserved for the wealthiest families, featuring private beaches, VIP facilities, and impenetrable security. The perfect place to spend the best summer of your life. But everything falls apart when the police storm the resort to investigate a mysterious disappearance. In such an exclusive place, everyone is a suspect — and no one can leave until the culprit is found.

items.title: I Will Find You
items.description: Wrongfully imprisoned for murdering his own son, a father sets out on a desperate rescue mission after learning the boy may still be alive.

items.title: Proud
items.description: When his carefree life is upended by an unexpected family tragedy, Filip is forced to grow up or risk losing all that he has left.

items.title: Raakh
items.description: When two teenagers vanish, a close-knit family is shattered and the city is left on edge. Determined to uncover the truth, a relentless officer leads a nationwide manhunt that pulls him deep into a world of violence and human depravity.

items.title: The Evil Lawyer
items.description: When a young attorney is accused of murdering a police officer's son, he teams up with the "Evil Lawyer" to exploit loopholes and prove his innocence.

items.title: Viral Hit
items.description: A bullied high schooler becomes an overnight sensation after a viral video. But when his newfound fame turns sour, he must learn to fight for himself.

items.title: Every Year After
items.description: Six summers to fall in love. One moment to fall apart. A week to get it right. A fun, sweeping, romantic story that asks the question, what if your first love actually was your soulmate?

items.title: Alice and Steve
items.description: Alice is devastated when her best friend Steve starts dating her 26-year-old daughter Izzy. She's going to lose her best friend and her daughter in one fell swoop. Alice tries everything she can to end the relationship. Unfortunately for her, Steve's more than ready for the attack, and what begins as a perfect friendship, devolves into an all-out feud.

items.title: The Pyramid Scheme
items.description: Follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.

items.title: Teach You a Lesson
items.description: An inspector from the Educational Rights Protection Bureau (ERPB) who is authorized by the government to use physical intervention and unconventional methods to discipline delinquent students and reform the educational system.

items.title: Among Us
items.description: Eccentric, monochromatic crewmates of a ship transporting junk across the galaxy must root out an Impostor in their midst before they fall victim to its villainous designs.

items.title: Two Years Later
items.description: Daily bus flirtations between Emily and Ryan end with COVID. Two years later, they reunite and embark on eight dates to test marriage compatibility, facing personal challenges and differing views while finding true connection.

items.title: The Witness
items.description: With their 2-year-old as the sole witness to her murder, Rachel Nickell's partner fights to protect him amid a flawed investigation.

items.title: Cape Fear
items.description: When convicted murderer Max Cady is released from prison, he begins infiltrating the family of the married attorneys who helped put him behind bars.

items.title: Michael Jackson: The Verdict
items.description: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.

items.title: Made in India: A Titan Story
items.description: In a market ruled by smuggling and foreign brands, a determined Indian man Xerxes Desai, with the help of his team, dares to build a world-class watch from scratch. Battling rejection, failure, and global humiliation, they transform Titan into a symbol of national pride and innovation.

items.title: The Fortune
items.description: Amanda Blakefield's life is a happy one, with her husband Jimmy and their son Luke. But when Amanda is left an enormous inheritance by a man she has neither met nor heard of before, her life starts to fall apart. Amanda becomes embroiled in the world of the Worralls, where Martin Worrall is head of a family bound in past secrets. As Amanda is drawn further and further into past events and relationships, all of their lives are turned upside down.

items.title: Not Suitable for Work
items.description: Follow five work-obsessed twenty-somethings striving for professional success and, if they have time, personal happiness in Manhattan's most glamorous neighborhood, Murray Hill.

items.title: Bring Me the Beauties: A Model Cult
items.description: Learn how Hoyt Richards was drawn into the spiritual group Eternal Values by its enigmatic leader Frederick von Mierers.

items.title: Doctor on the Edge
items.description: In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji-ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

items.title: Torn Apart
items.description: Aras, a fearless seventeen-year-old boy, comes to Bodrum to search for his younger sibling, the only remaining member of his family whom he lost at the age of five. His new life in Bodrum will turn into a challenging struggle when his path crosses with the Akkaya family, the most powerful family in the city.

items.title: Tip Toe
items.description: Neighbours Leo and Clive have lived next door for 15 years, and become deadly enemies as the world around them grows more tense, exploring the prejudices creeping into modern life.

items.title: Reborn Rookie
items.description: After a powerful conglomerate chairman is betrayed by his children and wakes up in the body of a young soccer player, he uses his business genius and athletic physique to seek ultimate revenge against his family.

items.title: Ticket to Heaven
items.description: A grieving student pursuing priesthood faces a crisis of faith when he falls for a troubled new classmate in a world ruled by strict dogma.

items.title: Brazil '70: The Third Star
items.description: In 1970, the Brazilian national team took the field with big dreams and an even bigger challenge: to become the first three-time world champions.

items.title: A Dog and a Plane
items.description: After a chaotic luggage mix-up, a broke paramedic and an ambitious flight attendant grow closer while exposing a cheating boyfriend’s secrets.

items.title: Make That Movie
items.description: Make That Movie follows a hotshot director, played by stand-up comedian and actor Sam Campbell, scouring the country for everyday people who have an idea for a feature film. Sam and his team then race against the clock as they attempt to transform the idea into a film in just three days.

items.title: Star City
items.description: Step into a thrilling chapter inspired by For All Mankind. Same alt-history universe. Different perspective: the Soviet Union's. Go behind the Iron Curtain with the cosmonauts, engineers, and intelligence officers who risked it all in the race for the Moon.

items.title: My 2 Cents
items.description: When his friend Wild Boar lands himself in hot water with organized crime, Zero and the gang unite to save him while barely coping with their own lives.

items.title: Camatarii
items.description: One of the most feared clans in Romania tells its inside story for the first time. This is not just the history of a clan. It is the story of a transition, of a Romania that paid dearly for the price of freedom.

items.title: World War II with Tom Hanks
items.description: Explores WWII from Germany's invasion of Poland through the atomic age, examining pivotal battles, wartime leaders like Churchill and Roosevelt, and the human cost of total war.

items.title: Spider-Noir
items.description: Ben Reilly, an aging and down on his luck private investigator in 1930s New York, is forced to grapple with his past life as the city's one and only superhero.

items.title: Two Weeks in August
items.description: A Greek holiday with friends to relax and reconnect. But when Zoe acts on her desires, heaven quickly turns into hell. Witty, painfully relatable drama starring Jessica Raine.

items.title: Mating Season
items.description: Set in the animal world, the series follows a cast of bears, raccoons, deer, foxes and a host of other horny, lovable forest critters, as they navigate love, sexual relationships and the universal need to hook up and find a partner.

items.title: Se tiene que morir mucha gente
items.description: N/A

items.title: The Boroughs
items.description: In a seemingly perfect retirement community, a crew of unlikely heroes must stop an otherworldly threat from stealing the one thing they don't have: time.

items.title: The Nightmare Upstairs: What Happened to Ty and Bryn?
items.description: When allegations of abuse irrevocably fracture a Utah family, a bitter custody battle ensues. After the court orders the children into a controversial reunification program, Ty and Bryn take matters into their own hands by barricading themselves in a bedroom for 54 days, livestreaming their protest, and turning an intimate family crisis into a national viral reckoning.

items.title: Falling
items.description: A nun and priest, each dedicated to their religious calling, unexpectedly fall in love and must confront what this means for their vows and faith.

items.title: Maximum Pleasure Guaranteed
items.description: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder, and youth soccer.

items.title: You're Killing Me
items.description: In a quaint New England town, bestselling novelist Allie forms an unlikely alliance with aspiring writer and podcaster Andi to find the killer of a close friend.

items.title: Summer '36
items.description: Nice, 1936. As workers enjoy their first paid holidays, four very different women become entangled in the murder of a prosecutor at the Riviera hotel.

items.title: The Air
items.description: When a violent coup erupts back home, Princess Catherine Blew De Laina becomes an assassination target while visiting Thailand. Her survival falls entirely on Lieutenant 'Lom' Vayo Watinwanich, a sharp female marine police officer assigned as her underground protector. Forced off the grid, the two women must navigate relentless tactical hits and political betrayal. As duty and survival blur, their isolation sparks an intense, undeniable magnetic attraction—a forbidden love defying rigid military protocol and royal expectations. Amidst constant gunfire, Blew finds safety in Lom's embrace, while Lom discovers a kindred spirit beneath the royal exterior. In a world where everyone has a price, their fierce devotion becomes both their ultimate liability and their only way out. Together, they must dismantle the conspiracy before the assassins close in.

items.title: Hathras 16 Days
items.description: A young Dalit girl is gang‑raped and left fighting for life. When she dares to name her attackers, her truth is buried, while her family fights for justice in a system that fails her even after death.

items.title: Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
items.description: Hungry for a new heist, Berlin summons the gang to Seville and turns an ambitious duke into the victim of his own plan: to steal a da Vinci masterpiece.

items.title: Dutton Ranch
items.description: Rip Wheeler and Beth Dutton gamble everything on a new life in South Texas, but the promise of building a future far from the ghosts of Yellowstone quickly collides with brutal new realities and a rival ranch that will stop at nothing to protect its empire.

items.title: The WONDERfools
items.description: A goofy group of townies stumbles into superpowers and fights rising evil as doomsday panic grows in this wild, turn-of-the-century action comedy.

items.title: Nemesis
items.description: A relentless LAPD cop becomes obsessed with taking down the master thief behind a string of daring heists — and only one can come out on top.

items.title: Soul Mate
items.description: In a moment of despair, Ryu Narutaki finds himself saved by Korean boxer Johan Hwang. As their wounded souls draw closer, their fates cruelly intertwine.

items.title: Between Father and Son
items.description: In just a few suspenseful minutes, a lawyer's world tilts as her visit to her fiancé's family estate ignites an irresistible bond with her future stepson.

items.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
items.description: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

items.title: Regular Show: The Lost Tapes
items.description: Familiar duo Mordecai and Rigby navigate mundane park jobs that inevitably spiral into surreal, chaotic disasters.

items.title: Believe Me
items.description: The horrific true story of John Worboys, one of the most notorious serial rapists in British history. His modus operandi was to tell women in his cab that he’d won some money and then persistently offer them a glass of champagne, which he’d laced with drugs, and which rendered his victims unconscious. He was convicted in 2009 for sexually assaulting 12 women between 2006 and 2008, with their cases selected from a large number of suspected further victims.

items.title: Double Helix
items.description: Years after being torn apart by family and fate, two former lovers reunite as boss and employee, forced to confront a love they can't escape.

items.title: The Palu Family: Under a Dark Spell
items.description: An investigation into one of Turkey's most shocking cases -- and how one man was able to enact total control over a tight-knit family.

items.title: My Royal Nemesis
items.description: A Joseon-era villain doomed to die opens her eyes in modern-day Seoul — where a ruthless chaebol heir may be her last chance to rewrite her fate.

items.title: M.I.A.
items.description: Restless in the Florida Keys, Etta Tiger Jonze dreams of a life in Miami's glittering, sub-tropical kingdom. When her family's drug-running business shatters in tragedy, however, Etta embarks on a dangerous journey through Miami's neon-lit underbelly that will define who she is and what she's ultimately capable of.

items.title: Legends
items.description: As drugs flood the streets of '90s Britain, a team of civil servants is thrust undercover to topple the gangs behind it.

items.title: Enemies with Benefits
items.description: Head of Sales Lal is determined to triumph over Head of Accounting Wine. Wine is her polar opposite and known for her mercilessness. When a wild night leads them to a friends with benefits relationship, they'll do anything to keep it a secret, pretending to be enemies so that absolutely no one at work finds out. Without realising it, however, their newfound closeness begins to give way to love.

items.title: Golden Boys
items.description: Stockholm 1997. Eco-criminal Joachim Posener, recently released from prison, dreams of building an empire. He wants to show his parents and his seven-year-old son that he can achieve anything. Joachim joins forces with his boundless cousin, Thomas Jisander. They call themselves the Golden Boys and party hard, dream big and plan an extremely illegal business scheme. The series is inspired by the Trustor affair.

items.title: The Glass House
items.description: A determined immigrant builds his way up from zero in Quebec's competitive 1990s business landscape, navigating challenges and opportunities while creating a successful enterprise.

items.title: Glory
items.description: In a small-town boxing hub, two brothers investigate a shocking murder while navigating a troubled reunion with their father, a renowned coach.

items.title: Prisoner
items.description: A young and ambitious prison officer finds herself in the middle of a battle for the criminal underworld as crime lords try to evade justice. But in order to do that, she will have to learn quickly to put her faith in one of the very men she wants to put behind bars.

items.title: Man on Fire
items.description: Haunted by his past and hunted by his enemies, a Special Forces veteran fights to keep a teenage girl alive on the deadly streets of Rio de Janeiro.

items.title: Should I Marry a Murderer?
items.description: In 2020, pathologist Caroline Muirhead's fiancé, Scottish farmer Alexander 'Sandy' McKellar, confessed to her that he and his twin brother Robert had killed cyclist Tony Parsons in a 2017 hit-and-run on the A82 near Bridge of Orchy and buried the body on the Auch Estate.

items.title: Gold Land
items.description: A young woman working as an airport security agent accidentally comes into possession of a smuggling ring’s gold bars. Caught in a chaotic whirlwind of greed and betrayal among various parties vying for the gold, she becomes consumed by the desire to claim it all for herself.

items.title: The House of the Spirits
items.description: The epic tale of a proud and passionate family, secret loves, and bloody revolution. The Trueba family's passions, struggles, and secrets span a century of violent social change, culminating in a crisis that hurls the proud, tyrannical patriarch and his beloved granddaughter towards opposite sides of the fence.

items.title: Widow's Bay
items.description: The mayor of a New England town resolves to turn it into the next tourist hot spot, despite local warnings that it's cursed.

items.title: Half Man
items.description: When Niall's estranged 'brother' Ruben shows up at his wedding, it leads to an explosion of violence that catapults us back through their lives.

items.title: Must Date the Playboy!
items.description: A fake relationship. A hidden agenda. A shy girl and a notorious playboy enter a dangerous game of love — where the biggest mistake they can make… is falling for each other.

items.title: Unconditional
items.description: A mother-daughter vacation abroad takes a devastating turn when Gali is arrested for drug possession. Refusing to accept the charges, her mother Orna risks everything on a quest for freedom—only to get entangled in a web of Gali's secrets.

items.title: Straight to Hell
items.description: As Japan's most famous fortune teller, Kazuko Hosoki ruled TV and bestseller lists, but who was she behind rumors of spiritual scams and underworld ties?

items.title: Secret Service
items.description: A British intelligence officer Kate Henderson races against time to uncover a UK politician's potential ties with the Kremlin, risking her reputation and family, as a murder and election loom.

items.title: The Cage
items.description: When Leanne and Matty discover they are both robbing from the safe at the inner-city casino they work in, their lives are set on a collision course; with each other, the local gangster they're stealing from, and the police.

items.title: Filing for Love
items.description: A romantic comedy about Joo In-ah, a charismatic audit department head with a secret, and Noh Ki-joon, the department's ace who is suddenly demoted to deal with the company's scandals.

items.title: If Wishes Could Kill
items.description: A mysterious app promises wishes — then starts a countdown to death. As a group of teens becomes entangled, they must break the deadly chain to survive.

items.title: Naughty Business
items.description: When her husband falls into a coma, Nines, a traditional housewife, transforms the family business into the first adult video store in Valladolid.

items.title: Flunked
items.description: Eddy, a math genius and small-time crook, avoids jail-time by going undercover as a teacher. His mission: to identify the kid of a major criminal.

items.title: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
items.description: Winter. Hawkins. 1985. Welcome back to a town crawling with secrets, where beloved heroes are facing fresh mysteries... and an all-new breed of strange.

items.title: Sold Out on You
items.description: A work-obsessed cosmetics CEO and a top home-shopping host struggling with insomnia cross paths, and through an unexpected romance, begin to heal the emptiness in their lives.

items.title: Unchosen
items.description: When a young mother from a sheltered cult crosses paths with a mysterious stranger, she embarks on a risky affair that awakens desires and dark secrets.

items.title: The Scarecrow
items.description: A fiercely competitive police officer and an idealistic prosecutor, former high school classmates, reunite while investigating a nationwide serial murder case, pulling them into both a dangerous pursuit and an unresolved personal past.

items.title: Kevin
items.description: A life-long housecat decides that he doesn’t want to live with people anymore. Loosely inspired by a real break-up and the cat caught in the middle, Kevin dares to ask himself, "Is there a world where I don’t do the owner thing and am just… single for the rest of my life?"

items.title: Mint
items.description: Shannon is the only daughter of an infamous crime family that rules the region, a real-life princess who has never wanted for anything. But when she meets Arran, a member of a rival gang, their whirlwind romance begins to unravel the world she’s always known.

items.title: We Are All Trying Here
items.description: An aspiring director hits rock bottom after 20 years chasing his debut — until he meets an overwhelmed producer who helps him rediscover his self-worth.

items.title: Absolute Value of Romance
items.description: High schooler Yeo Eui-ju secretly writes web novels by night. When four charming new teachers arrive, they inspire her stories and shake up her school.

items.title: Matka King
items.description: In this fictional tale set in 1960s Mumbai, an enterprising cotton trader who craves legitimacy and respect, starts a new gambling game dubbed ‘Matka’, that takes the city by storm and democratizes a terrain previously reserved for the rich and elite.

items.title: Someone Has to Know
items.description: A boy vanishes, and no one can find him. An open-and-shut case, except there are no leads. Three hundred people around him, and no one saw anything?

items.title: The Dark Wizard
items.description: An unflinching portrait of Dean Potter, the world's most influential and controversial climber, base jumper and highline walker, who achieves jaw-dropping feats while battling his inner demons.

items.title: Margo's Got Money Troubles
items.description: The daughter of a former Hooter's waitress and an ex-pro wrestler, Margo is a recent college dropout and aspiring writer. Faced with a new baby, mounting pile of bills, and dwindling number of ways to pay them, Margo must find a way forward.

items.title: Missed Call
items.description: In a picturesque French village, English single mother Sarah's daughter disappears while on a school exchange trip, soon after attempting a late-night call to her mother. Despite indifference from local authorities and the host family, Sarah goes on a search for her daughter that spirals into a dangerous race against time.

items.title: LIS
items.description: LIS follows four ambitious medical interns working at a struggling Norwegian hospital. Facing the harsh realities of an overstretched medical system, with rising patient numbers and dwindling resources, the young interns grapple with the complex ethical dilemmas of providing care in a system stretched to its limits. They will learn that compassion alone may not be enough, and they are forced to grow in ways they never expected.

items.title: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
items.description: After shielding himself and his daughter from his family for over a decade, Malcolm is dragged back into their orbit when Hal and Lois demand his presence at their 40th anniversary party.

items.title: Perfect Crown
items.description: In 21st-century Korea under a constitutional monarchy, a chaebol heiress with everything but status tries to take control of her future after crossing paths with a lonely prince with nothing but his title. Together, bound by a contract marriage, they begin a class-defying romance to rewrite destiny.

items.title: Big Mistakes
items.description: Blackmailed into working for some very dangerous people, two deeply incapable siblings become the most disorganized duo in organized crime.

items.title: Bandi
items.description: Following the death of their mother, their pillar of strength and their anchor, eleven siblings aged 7 to 23 try to stay united in the face of adversity. But for some of them, drug trafficking seems to be the only way to survive. A decision far from being unanimously accepted, and one that severely tests the strength of their family bonds.

items.title: The Miniature Wife
items.description: Lindy and Les, a married writer and scientist, are forced to re-evaluate the power balances in their relationship after a freak accident shrinks Lindy down to 6 inches tall.

items.title: Zung: The Rust
items.description: In Alang's ship-breaking yards, Kaveri's perfect marriage conceals deadly secrets. An affair leads to blackmail and murder, triggering a police probe that unravels betrayal and manipulation. She faces the consequences of her choices.

items.title: Twenty Twenty Six
items.description: 48 countries, three host nations - what can possibly go wrong? Former BBC head of values Ian Fletcher is saving the World Cup. So that's all good then. Starring Hugh Bonneville.

items.title: Trust Me: The False Prophet
items.description: In this true-crime documentary, a cult expert and filmmaker infiltrate a polygamist sect to expose a self-proclaimed prophet and bring him to justice.

items.title: The Testaments
items.description: Growing up in Gilead is all they have ever known. As a new generation of young women grapple with the bleak future that awaits them, they will be forced to search for allies, new and old, to help in their fight for freedom.

items.title: A Taste for Murder
items.description: Joe Mottram, a widowed metropolitan police detective, takes his daughter to Capri for the summer to stay with his in-laws. As they struggle to overcome their grief, Mottram becomes immersed in helping solve local crimes.

items.title: The Gentleman
items.description: Yusuf, who grew up in the suburbs of Istanbul, is a young man who tries to keep his family afloat and does not bow to injustice. While he dreams of a modest life with his childhood sweetheart Hazan, fate drags him into the middle of the underworld, power games and class conflict. When he reappears years later with a completely different identity, nothing is the same anymore; The wounds of the past and the hidden secrets will force him to follow both his heart and his revenge.

items.title: Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord
items.description: After the Clone Wars, Maul plots to rebuild his criminal syndicate on a planet untouched by the Empire.

items.title: Finding Harry: The Craft Behind The Magic
items.description: This exclusive special offers an inside look at the epic scale and meticulous care behind HBO's new Harry Potter series-told through the lens of the artists, craftspeople, and technicians bringing J.K. Rowling's books to life for a new generation.

items.title: The Audacity
items.description: Inside the bubble of Silicon Valley, a data-mining CEO strives to turn insight and influence into profit and power in this darkly comedic look at the warped dreams, outsized egos, and ethical lapses of the self-styled inventors of the future.

items.title: Hometown Romance
items.description: Si, a high-society heiress, dreams of becoming the president of her family’s company. However, her parents give the position to her younger sister instead, believing Si is too spoiled and irresponsible, spending millions without a second thought. When the family business faces a crisis involving a crucial land lease renewal, negotiations fail—until Klaokavee, the landowner, makes an unusual proposal: she will renew the lease only if Si agrees to marry her. Despite their completely opposite lifestyles, this strange arrangement brings the two into an unexpected and complicated relationship.

items.title: Sins of Kujo
items.description: From thugs to yakuza, Taiza Kujo wields the law to defend society's worst. Fellow lawyer, Karasuma doubts his ethics but joins him in facing the abyss.

items.title: Agent from Above
items.description: Bound by a deity's pact, Han Chieh fights demons on Earth. When he uncovers an old enemy's plan for a second invasion, he must fight to save humanity.

items.title: Dear Killer Nannies
items.description: Juan Pablo, Pablo Escobar's son, has an atypical childhood and lives surrounded by hitmen who work as his nannies. He idealizes his father, considering him a benefactor, but as he grows up, he learns that his father is, in fact, a criminal.

items.title: Secrets of the Bees
items.description: With the expertise of entomologist and fellow National Geographic Explorer Dr. Samuel Ramsey, the series uses groundbreaking filming technology to reveal the extraordinary world of bees; and uncover their astonishing architecture and intelligence, unlocking their secrets and featuring never-before-filmed moments.

items.title: If It's Tuesday, It's Murder
items.description: A diverse group of tourists on an organized trip to Lisbon find themselves investigating a murder after one of them is killed on the first morning.

items.title: Babies
items.description: Lisa and Stephen are dealing with the painful struggle of pregnancy loss while life continues around them. However, despite facing dark times of grief and loneliness, they are finding their way through it with a burning sense of hope, humour, and love, realising the strength of their relationship, which will ultimately bring them closer than ever.

items.title: Love Beyond the Grave
items.description: The exceptionally gifted Ghost King, He Simu, unexpectedly encounters the young general, Duan Xu, while out on a break, searching for food. This young general, who carries an item belonging to someone from He Simu's past, seems not to be the real Duan Xu. As they test each other through subtle exchanges, He Simu gradually uncovers the dark past and aspirations hidden within Duan Xu’s heart. In turn, Duan Xu discovers the steadfastness and loneliness that He Simu has endured. Despite the fleeting lifespan of a mortal, no more than a hundred years, and the four-hundred-year-old ghost who still retains the appearance of a young girl, they resist the relentless passage of time through their love.

items.title: The Predator of Seville
items.description: For years, Manuel Blanco was known among international students as “Manu White”, a friendly guide who organised cheap trips across Spain. But behind that image lay a far darker story. The case came to light when several young women began to connect experiences of abuse that had previously seemed unrelated.

items.title: BROKEN (Of) LOVE
items.description: Arisa is a woman who seeks revenge on a capitalist behind her mother’s murder; but while doing so, she falls in love with the enemy’s daughter.

items.title: Muthu Alias Kaattaan
items.description: A story of an man who becomes a legend, a Monster, and a Miracle, depending on the Storyteller.

items.title: Privileges
items.description: Hoping for a last chance at redemption, a young inmate takes a job inside a luxury Parisian hotel rife with ruthless ambition and betrayal.

items.title: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
items.description: A bride has a feeling that something horrifying will happen at her wedding — and the closer to the altar she gets, the worse it becomes.

items.title: Detective Hole
items.description: When a series of ritualistic murders hits Oslo, a gifted detective must navigate a puzzle of patterns, corruption and his own demons to catch the killer.

items.title: We'll Be Fine
items.description: Aktan and Lal, two polar opposites who meet at a party, find themselves caught up in a grand love story. Their fairytale romance spirals into chaos as they change everything in their lives to be together.

items.title: Bait
items.description: Shah Latif is a struggling actor on the cusp of landing the role of a lifetime, only to find himself thrust into a full blown existential crisis and trippy conspiracy thriller all at the same time.

items.title: Lucky Luke
items.description: Lucky Luke, the legendary lone cowboy, must team up with Louise, a fearless young woman searching for her missing mother. Together, they face the dangers of the Wild West, ally with old enemies like the Daltons or Billy the Kid - and learn to get along. This quest may reveal a far greater threat and lead Luke back to the origins of his legend.

items.title: Crookhaven
items.description: Set at mysterious Crookhaven School, high achieving young crooks from across the world are secretly selected to hone their skills in disciplines such as Deception, Crimnastics, Forgery and Infiltration, learning how to use their skills for good and to do what is right in their own way.

items.title: The Faithful
items.description: This event series is told through the eyes of the courageous and passionate, yet flawed women whose descendants would shape three of the world's great faiths: Judaism, Christianity and Islam.

items.title: Hope Valley: 1874
items.description: Back to the earliest days of the community that would one day grow into beloved Hope Valley, exploring faith, courage, and the joy of building a life together from the ground up.

items.title: The Water
items.description: When 'Nam' Apo Watinwanich, the heir to the Watin Group hotel chain, meets a troublemaker, 'Lada' Chonlada Kunanon, the new receptionist who comes to cause chaos and change the life of a talented female executive who is always focused on work. A relationship full of tricks, between a game of hate and love, which will reach the finish line first?

items.title: Chiraiya
items.description: Kamlesh's world as a devoted wife and daughter-in-law shatters when her new sister-in-law confides a disturbing secret about her wedding night, forcing Kamlesh to confront uncomfortable truths within her own family.

items.title: Sogn Murders
items.description: In a fjord community facing the closure of its only police station, detective Ole Vik gets an oddly timed new trainee whose arrival coincides with something far darker than small-town life should ever see.

items.title: Radioactive Emergency
items.description: Physicists and doctors race to contain a massive radiological disaster and save thousands of lives.
